app.title: Branchery
confirm.discard.behind: It takes the {count} commits the remote is ahead by with it, which is what the branch is being put onto.
confirm.discard.behind.one: It takes the 1 commit the remote is ahead by with it, which is what the branch is being put onto.
confirm.discard.body: The branch is put back exactly on {upstream}. The commits below are then in no branch — "git reflog" in this worktree still finds them until git next collects, and nothing else does.
confirm.discard.title: Drop what was never pushed?
confirm.sync.body: The worktree gets a copy of the data of the project checkout. Its own database is written anew — whatever is in it now is gone.
confirm.sync.title: Copy the data again?
confirm.worktree.body: All of this goes, and it cannot be undone.
confirm.worktree.changes: {count} changes in this worktree were never committed. They go with it.
confirm.worktree.changes.one: 1 change in this worktree was never committed. It goes with it.
confirm.worktree.nowhere: This branch is on no remote — everything on it is here and nowhere else.
confirm.worktree.title: Remove worktree?
confirm.worktree.unpushed: {count} commits on this branch were never pushed.
confirm.worktree.unpushed.one: 1 commit on this branch was never pushed.
detail.accountMissing: This worktree inherited its data, and its accounts came with it.
detail.branchHasWorktree: This branch is checked out in
detail.busy: {doing}. The actions are back once it is over.
detail.busyHeading: An operation is running on this worktree
detail.changeFailed: The change could not be read.
detail.changeTruncated: The change is longer than what is shown here.
detail.changesFailed: What is uncommitted could not be read.
detail.commitFailed: This commit could not be read.
detail.commitsFailed: What is on this branch could not be read.
detail.discardBlocked: Not while the worktree has uncommitted changes: putting the branch back would write over them. Commit or stash them first.
detail.historyFailed: The history could not be read.
detail.logFailed: The log could not be read.
detail.noHistory: Nothing has been done to this worktree yet.
detail.noLog: The log of this operation is gone.
detail.nothingUncommitted: Everything in this worktree is committed now.
detail.onRemoteOnly: on the remote, not here yet
detail.pullBlocked: Nothing to bring in: the branch has everything its remote has. Fetch from the remote first if that may have moved.
detail.stale: What the build reads (composer.json, composer.lock, the recipe) has changed since this worktree was built, so what is installed and set up here was made for other code. Provisioning again puts that right. A commit of your own that changes none of them is not this.
detail.staleHeading: The dependencies changed since it was built
detail.touchedNothing: A merge changes nothing of its own: what it did is what the two sides did.
detail.unfinished: A build was begun in this worktree and stopped before its end. Some of what a finished worktree has is here and some is not. Provisioning again takes it from the top.
detail.unfinishedAt: The build stopped in step {no}, "{step}": {reason} Provisioning again takes it from the top; the history below has everything the step wrote.
edit.effect.php: The worktree gets a pool of its own and answers on it right away.
edit.step.php.heading: Which PHP version for {name}?
edit.step.php.lead: Only the versions this worktree can actually run are offered. It takes effect right away.
edit.step.review.heading: What will change on {name}
error.branchExists: There is already a branch called "{branch}". Check it out instead, or pick another name.
error.branchName: A branch name may only hold letters, digits and . _ - / and has to start with a letter or a digit.
error.recipe: The project’s recipe cannot be used, so operations will refuse until it is fixed:
error.unconfigured: This project has not said how its worktrees are built
error.unconfiguredHow: A worktree is a checkout at an address of its own, with nothing installed and nothing set up. Run "ddev branchery config:example --profile=typo3-app --write" and edit the file it writes.
error.unreachable: The project could not be read. What is on the page is what was last known — the container may be restarting.
exposed.container: This project has no DDEV router, so the port is published straight out of the container and reaches every interface. Anything on the network beside you can reach this page — and it runs the project’s tools without asking who is asking.
exposed.heading: This interface is reachable from the network
exposed.router: DDEV is set to bind on every interface, so anything on the network beside you can reach this page — and it runs the project’s tools without asking who is asking. Turn "bind_all_interfaces" off, or take this machine off that network.
field.branchFilter: Search or type a branch name
job.done.remove: "{name}" is removed — worktree, branch and database.
job.done.sync: The project's data is copied into {name}.
job.interrupted: The operation was stopped before it finished — its process is gone. The container may have been restarted.
job.unknown: Nothing is known about this operation
mode.branchHint: A branch that already exists on the remote gets a checkout of its own.
mode.branchNone: There is no branch without a worktree right now.
mode.forkHint: A new branch, started from the project checkout or from another worktree.
overview.noMatch: No worktree matches. Escape shows them all again.
overview.unfinished.one: The build of {names} did not finish.
preview.databaseCopy: copy of {name}, on the project's server
preview.isProject: "{name}" is the name of the project itself. A worktree of that name would be taken for the project checkout at every door, so pick another.
preview.phpRead: read from {file} once the checkout is there
provision.freshHint: The database is dropped and the application installed from scratch. Everything in it goes — content, editors, whatever was set up in the backend.
provision.heading: Build {name} again?
provision.keepHint: The database stays and is fitted to the code that is checked out now — schema and extension state.
provision.lead: Dependencies, configuration, docroot and PHP version are made again either way. The data is the choice.
step.branch.noMatch: No branch matches. What you typed is taken as it stands.
step.fork.heading: What is the new branch called?
step.fork.label: Branch
step.fork.lead: The branch is created off the source you pick and pushed nowhere until you do it yourself.
step.mode.heading: What do you want to work on?
step.mode.label: Kind
step.mode.lead: Both give you a worktree of your own — with its own address, its own PHP and its own database.
step.review.heading: This is what will be created
step.review.label: Summary
step.review.lead: Nothing has happened yet. Go back to change an answer.
table.author: Author
table.empty: No worktree yet. Create one to get started.
table.subject: Subject
tidy.heading: Worktrees that look finished
tidy.lead: Ticked where nothing can be lost. Each one takes its branch and its database with it.
tidy.why.gone: The branch is gone from the remote. Its own commits may not be in the project’s branch.
tidy.why.merged: Every commit is in the project’s branch — nothing is lost.
update.how: Restart the project and the new one takes over: ddev restart. A container keeps the image it was made from, so nothing changes until it is replaced.
update.waiting: Branchery has been updated. This project is still running the version before it.
